messages:
Maya (Sales AE): Quick sync: OrionMed wants an on-prem POC using our Private appliance + Dedicated GPUs. Theyre strict on no external pulls; everything must be mirrored. Need a short "preflight + access" note for InfoSec and Procurement. POC target: 2 weeks next month.
Ibrahim (Infra Eng): Understood. I'll draft a compact preflight. Key items: GPU driver, CUDA version, container runtime, k8s version, device-plugin, node labels, kernel modules, NTP. Also mirror procedure for images/artifacts.
Jo (Solutions Eng): Add token exchange flow for ephemeral access (bastion + mTLS). Also mention we support a local-only mode where the control plane never leaves the VPC.
Vera (FieldTech): For air-gapped installs: we supply an image bundle (tar.gz), helm chart, and a mirror tool. Customer must provide a registry (Harbor/Quay) reachable from nodes. We'll include example Harbor config.
Maya (Sales AE): Procurement wants a one-line summary of security: do you store customer keys? Are keys exported?
Ibrahim (Infra Eng): Short answer: No key export. We call customer KMS via transit (Vault or HSM). We never persist plaintext keys on our side. We'll add a sentence about PKCS#11 compatibility.
Jo (Solutions Eng): Ephemeral access flow (concise): 1) Sales creates POC session in Console (duration, allowed models). 2) Console mints signed grant. 3) Customer bastion + client certs POST grant to validate endpoint (mTLS). 4) Platform returns scoped credentials (1-6h). 5) Refresh via same flow.
Vera (FieldTech): Required local checks (commands to run):
```bash
# GPU and driver
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version --format=csv
# CUDA/toolkit
if command -v nvcc >/dev/null; then nvcc --version; else ls /usr/local | grep cuda || true; fi
# Kernel modules
uname -r; lsmod | egrep 'nvidia|nvrm' || true
# Container runtime
ps -ef | egrep 'containerd|dockerd' || true
# k8s version (from a user with view rights)
kubectl version --short
```
Ibrahim (Infra Eng): Also check that nodes expose these ports internally for install: kube-apiserver 6443, node-exporter 9100, DCGM 9400. For mirror sync we need outbound to our artifact-proxy only during initial exchange if customer allows; otherwise manual transfer of tarballs works.
Maya (Sales AE): Pricing note: procurement asked for 4x A100 POC for 14 days. Can finance give a ballpark?
procurement-bot: Quote request created: orionmed/poc/1871234567. Marcus from Finance will reply.
Marcus (Finance): Ballpark: pro-rated commit for 4x A100 ~ $12.5k for 14 days. Formal quote pending with support hours line-item.
Jo (Solutions Eng): InfoSec will ask about TLS ciphers and cert formats for the mTLS exchange. We'll recommend TLS1.2+ and ECDHE ciphers. Include openssl snippets.
Vera (FieldTech): Known gotchas to call out: SELinux enforcing blocks plugin mounts (recommend Permissive during install), older kernels <5.10 lack some NV driver support, cgroup v2 issues with docker legacy. Also ensure VM BIOS settings (SR-IOV passthrough if used) are enabled.
OrionMed-ops: We can prep three nodes and run checks Tue morning. Also we use Harbor and internal Vault.
Maya (Sales AE): Great. Ibrahim / Jo, can you prepare the one-page preflight and short FAQ (3 bullets) by EOD so I can share with OrionMed procurement/legal?
Ibrahim (Infra Eng): Will do. I'll keep the checklist terse and include commands + compatibility matrix link.
Jo (Solutions Eng): I'll add the token flow diagram and the TLS snippet.
Maya (Sales AE): Thanks all. OrionMed-ops, once you upload the node outputs we'll review and flag blockers quickly. :thumbsup:
